revisionDesc.change: Finalized - Ready. From the image it is clear that there are traces of line 9 at the end of the first fragment and traces of line 10 at the beginning of the second fragment. So I have left the line numbering as it was.
Vote - Return-Straight-to-Sender - Thank you, but could you please enter the corrections from BL 13.79?

Vote - AcceptText - See Sosin's comments. I would be inclined to enter the end of lin15 without the alternative readings. Lin8 <:χρεωστεῖν|reg|χρεωστῖν:> (I checked the photo, which makes this clear, the ed.pr. is misleading).

Vote - AcceptText - Accept. Del fragm divs and treat in a single ordinary text div; Lin6: confirmed rho-cross on digital image; lin3 del '' 2x; lin --> ΐ 2x: this is a modern accent, not an ancient one; lin5--> [ἀπὸ] [ca.6]; lin8 *middot* --> ·; lin15 if we are to include the note at lin15 then include the entire string--> <:.1ησον||alt||π̣ησον|υ̣τ̣ησον|τ̣τ̣ησον|υ̣υ̣ησον|γ̣γ̣ησον|{.1} τ̣ῆς ὀν:>
Entered Greek text from CPR 19.10; lin6 would prefer staurogram (which is not the same as a chirho christogram)instead of stauros (fotochecked); lin8apparatus superfluous (?)
